items.name: Foundry of Databricks
items.blurb: A handcrafted stop-motion puppet trophy representing the unified Delta triangle and Spark lightning of Databricks.

items.name: Foundations of Analysis and Science Seal
items.blurb: This wax seal honors the dual mastery of analytical reporting and predictive data science foundations.

items.name: The Compass of the Cascading Workspace
items.blurb: Awarded for mastering the intricate pathways of Databricks Workspace Navigation, finding the golden routes through catalog tables under the icy gaze of the data dragon.

items.name: The Great Clefs and Placement Felt Trophy
items.blurb: A whimsical hand-stitched felt creation celebrating note placement and key clefs, flanked by an angel, alligator, and friends who have gathered to learn the staff.
